function.name: get_scroll_info_ptr
function.description: This function retrieves a pointer to the scroll information of a window. It can also allocate memory for a new scroll bar information structure if requested and if the window doesn't already have one.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window for which to get the scroll information.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to get the information. This parameter can be one of the following values: SB_HORZ, SB_VERT, SB_CTL, SB_BOTH.

parameters.name: alloc
parameters.description: If this parameter is TRUE and the window doesn't have a scroll bar information structure, the function allocates memory for a new one.

function.return_type: struct scroll_info pointer. It represents the scroll information of the window. If the window doesn't have a scroll bar information structure and the alloc parameter is FALSE, the function returns NULL.

function.name: release_scroll_info_ptr
function.description: This function releases the scroll information pointer by calling the user_unlock function.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the scroll information structure.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: show_scroll_bar
function.description: This function is used to show or hide the horizontal and vertical scroll bars of a window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the scroll bar(s) to be shown or hidden.

parameters.name: show_horz
parameters.description: If TRUE, the horizontal scroll bar is shown; otherwise, it is hidden.

parameters.name: show_vert
parameters.description: If TRUE, the vertical scroll bar is shown; otherwise, it is hidden.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the operation was successful or if the specified scroll bar does not exist. Returns FALSE if the operation failed.

function.name: get_scroll_bar_rect
function.description: This function retrieves the dimensions of the specified scroll bar, including the length of the arrow buttons, the size and position of the scroll box (thumb), and the length of the shaft.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that owns the scroll bar.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to retrieve dimensions.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that receives the dimensions of the specified scroll bar.

parameters.name: arrow_size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the length of the arrow button on the scroll bar.

parameters.name: thumb_size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the size of the scroll box.

parameters.name: thumb_pos
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the position of the scroll box.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, or FALSE otherwise.

function.name: draw_scroll_bar
function.description: This function is responsible for drawing a scroll bar in a window. It handles different types of scroll bars, including vertical, horizontal, and control scroll bars. It also manages the scroll bar's appearance based on various conditions, such as the window's style and the scroll bar's state.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the scroll bar.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context for the window.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar to be drawn.

parameters.name: hit_test
parameters.description: Specifies the part of the scroll bar that was hit.

parameters.name: tracking_info
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains information about the scroll bar's tracking.

parameters.name: draw_arrows
parameters.description: Specifies whether the scroll bar's arrows should be drawn.

parameters.name: draw_interior
parameters.description: Specifies whether the scroll bar's interior should be drawn.

function.return_type: void

function.name: draw_nc_scrollbar
function.description: This function draws horizontal and/or vertical scrollbars depending on the boolean values of 'draw_horizontal' and 'draw_vertical'.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window where the scrollbars are to be drawn.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context for the specified window.

parameters.name: draw_horizontal
parameters.description: Boolean value that determines whether to draw a horizontal scrollbar.

parameters.name: draw_vertical
parameters.description: Boolean value that determines whether to draw a vertical scrollbar.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: refresh_scroll_bar
function.description: This function refreshes the scroll bar by drawing it and then releasing the device context.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the scroll bar.

parameters.name: nBar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to redraw.

parameters.name: arrows
parameters.description: Determines whether the scroll bar arrows are drawn.

parameters.name: interior
parameters.description: Determines whether the interior of the scroll bar is drawn.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: point_in_scroll_rect
function.description: This function checks if a given point is within a scroll rectangle. It adjusts the rectangle dimensions based on whether the scroll is vertical or not before checking the point's position.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: A pointer to the rectangle structure representing the scroll area.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: The point to be checked if it's within the scroll rectangle.

parameters.name: vertical
parameters.description: A boolean value indicating whether the scroll is vertical or not.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the point is within the adjusted scroll rectangle, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: scroll_hit_test
function.description: This function tests where a given point falls in a scroll bar (top arrow, bottom arrow, top rectangle, bottom rectangle, or thumb) and returns the corresponding enum value. It also considers whether the scroll bar is vertical or horizontal.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that contains the scroll bar.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: An integer representing the scroll bar to be tested.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: A POINT structure that specifies the coordinates of the point to be tested.

parameters.name: dragging
parameters.description: A boolean value that specifies whether the scroll bar thumb is being dragged.

function.return_type: enum SCROLL_HITTEST, represents the part of the scroll bar where the point falls.

function.name: is_standard_scroll_painted
function.description: This function checks if the standard scroll is painted or not.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to get information

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the standard scroll is painted, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: get_thumb_val
function.description: This function calculates the value of a scrollbar thumb based on its position and other parameters.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the scrollbar.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to get the thumb value.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that specifies the dimensions of the scroll bar.

parameters.name: vertical
parameters.description: Specifies whether the scroll bar is vertical or horizontal.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Specifies the position of the scroll bar thumb.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the calculated value of the scrollbar thumb. Returns 0 if the scroll information pointer is null.

function.name: clip_scroll_pos
function.description: This function adjusts the x and y coordinates of a point to ensure they fall within the boundaries of a given rectangle.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a RECT structure that defines the boundaries within which the point's coordinates should fall.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: This is the point that will be adjusted to ensure it falls within the boundaries of the given rectangle.

function.return_type: POINT, representing the adjusted coordinates of the point to ensure it falls within the boundaries of the given rectangle.

function.name: update_scroll_timer
function.description: This function updates the scroll timer based on the hit test result. If the hit test matches the tracking info, it sends a message and sets the system timer. If not, it stops the scroll timer and kills the system timer.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window

parameters.name: owner_hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the owner window

parameters.name: ctl_hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the control window

parameters.name: hittest
parameters.description: Result of the hit test

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message to be processed

parameters.name: msg_send
parameters.description: Message to be sent

parameters.name: vertical
parameters.description: Indicates whether the scroll is vertical or not

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: handle_scroll_event
function.description: This function handles various scroll events such as mouse movements, button clicks, and system timers on a scroll bar. It also manages the scroll bar's appearance and position based on these events.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the scroll bar.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which the event is intended.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Specifies the message to be sent.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Specifies the coordinates of the mouse cursor, relative to the upper-left corner of the client area.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: track_scroll_bar
function.description: This function tracks the scroll bar events and handles them accordingly. It adjusts the point coordinates based on the window's rectangle and handles different types of mouse events. If the window is no longer valid, it releases the capture.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the scroll bar

parameters.name: scrollbar
parameters.description: The scrollbar that needs to be tracked

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: The coordinates of the point where the event occurred

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything

function.name: validate_scroll_info
function.description: This function validates the scroll information by checking the mask and size of the SCROLLINFO structure.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a SCROLLINFO structure that contains scroll bar parameters to be validated.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the scroll information is valid, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: get_scroll_info
function.description: This function retrieves the scroll information for a given window and bar. It validates the scroll information, gets the scroll info pointer, fills in the desired scroll info structure, releases the scroll info pointer, and finally traces the scroll info.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window for which scroll information is required

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to retrieve information

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a SCROLLINFO structure that receives the scroll bar information

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully retrieves the scroll information, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: set_scroll_info
function.description: This function sets the scroll information for a given window and scroll bar. It validates the scroll information, sets the page size, scroll position, and scroll range, ensures the page size and position are valid, checks if the scroll bar should be hidden or disabled, and returns the current position.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window for which the scroll information is to be set.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to set the scroll information.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a SCROLLINFO structure that contains the new scroll parameters.

parameters.name: redraw
parameters.description: Specifies whether the scroll bar is redrawn to reflect the changes to the scroll bar.

function.return_type: int, represents the current position of the scroll bar after the scroll information has been set.

function.name: get_scroll_bar_info
function.description: This function retrieves information about the scroll bar, including its state, position, and other related properties.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that contains the scroll bar.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The object identifier. The object identifier must be one of the predefined object identifiers or a custom object identifier.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a SCROLLBARINFO structure that receives the scroll bar information.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, or FALSE otherwise.

function.name: create_scroll_bar
function.description: This function creates a scroll bar and sets its properties based on the provided parameters.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that the scroll bar is to be created in.

parameters.name: create
parameters.description: A pointer to a CREATESTRUCTW structure that contains information about the scroll bar.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: handle_kbd_event
function.description: This function handles keyboard events, hides the caret on the first KEYDOWN to prevent flicker, and sends a message to the parent window depending on the key pressed.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that receives the message.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information, represents the virtual-key code of the key that is pressed.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information, used here to check if the PFD_DOUBLEBUFFER_DONTCARE flag is set.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: get_scroll_pos
function.description: This function retrieves the current position of the scroll bar.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that has the scroll bar.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to retrieve the position.

function.return_type: int, represents the current position of the scroll bar. Returns 0 if the scroll info pointer is null.

function.name: set_scroll_range
function.description: This function sets the scroll range of a given window and bar. It retrieves the scroll information, updates the minimum and maximum values, and then releases the scroll information.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to set the scroll range

parameters.name: min_val
parameters.description: Specifies the minimum scrolling position

parameters.name: max_val
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum scrolling position

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function executed successfully or not

function.name: get_scroll_range
function.description: This function retrieves the minimum and maximum scroll box positions for the specified scroll bar.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window with the scroll bar.

parameters.name: nBar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to retrieve the position.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Pointer to variable that receives the minimum scroll box position.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Pointer to variable that receives the maximum scroll box position.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function is successful, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: scroll_bar_window_proc
function.description: This function handles various messages for a scroll bar window. It processes different cases based on the message received and performs the corresponding operations.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message to be processed.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: ansi
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether the function should use the ANSI or Unicode character set.

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the message processing. The exact meaning depends on the message processed.

function.name: set_standard_scroll_painted
function.description: This function sets the painted property of the scroll bar (either horizontal or vertical) of a given window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the scroll bar.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar for which to set the painted property. This parameter can be either SB_HORZ for horizontal scroll bar or SB_VERT for vertical scroll bar.

parameters.name: painted
parameters.description: Specifies the new painted property for the scroll bar. If this parameter is TRUE, the scroll bar will be painted; if it is FALSE, the scroll bar will not be painted.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: NtUserShowScrollBar
function.description: This function is used to show or hide the scroll bar in the window specified by the HWND parameter. The type of scroll bar to be shown or hidden (vertical or horizontal) is determined by the INT parameter. The BOOL parameter determines whether to show or hide the scroll bar.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window with the scroll bar

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the type of scroll bar. This parameter can be one of the following values: SB_HORZ, SB_VERT

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Specifies whether the scroll bar is shown or hidden. If this parameter is TRUE, the scroll bar is shown; if it is FALSE, the scroll bar is hidden.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not. Returns TRUE if the operation is successful; otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserGetScrollBarInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the information about the scroll bar and sends a message to the window if the id is OBJID_CLIENT.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the scroll bar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the scroll bar

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a SCROLLBARINFO structure that receives the scroll bar information

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not

function.name: NtUserEnableScrollBar
function.description: This function enables or disables the scroll bar of a window based on the provided flags. It also refreshes the scroll bar and, in certain conditions, enables or disables the window itself.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window with the scroll bar that this function operates on.

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the scroll bar(s) to be enabled or disabled. This parameter can be one of the following values: SB_BOTH, SB_CTL, SB_HORZ, SB_VERT.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies how the scroll bar is to be enabled or disabled. This parameter can be one of the following values: ESB_DISABLE_BOTH, ESB_ENABLE_BOTH.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function successfully enables or disables the scroll bar. Returns FALSE if the function fails to enable or disable the scroll bar or if the scroll bar's flags match the provided flags.

function.name: NtUserSetScrollInfo
function.description: This function sets the scroll information for a specified window or control.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window or control

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Specifies the scroll bar to be set

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a SCROLLINFO structure that contains the new scroll parameters

parameters.name: redraw
parameters.description: Specifies whether the scroll bar is redrawn to reflect the new scroll parameters

function.return_type: INT, represents the current position of the scroll box of the specified scroll bar
